meta.name: dev-ccg
meta.description: Tri-model orchestration — run the same task through Claude + Codex + Gemini in parallel and synthesize the best answer. Use for high-stakes decisions where multi-model consensus reduces single-model bias.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行运行多个AI模型并综合最佳答案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在重要决策时借助多个AI模型减少偏差
copy.tagline_en: Run multiple AI models in parallel and synthesize the best answer
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to reduce bias in high-stakes decisions by consulting multiple AI models

howto.what: Claude 会并行调用三个模型（Claude、Codex、Gemini）处理同一请求，对比回答后合成综合答案。如果其他模型不可用，则降级为单模型并给出警告。
howto.when: 当你提出高风险决策、架构选择或需要多模型视角的代码审查等任务时触发。

say.note: Claude会并行调用三模型并返回合成结果。

say.text: 对比三个模型对这个架构设计的观点
say.note: Claude运行三模型并行生成并综合。

howto.what_en: Claude will parallelize the same request across Claude, Codex, and Gemini, compare their responses, and synthesize a combined answer. Falls back to single model with a warning if other models are unavailable.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for high-stakes decisions, architectural choices, or code reviews requiring multi-model perspectives.

say_en.text: Use CCG mode to review this code
say_en.note: Claude runs tri-model parallel and returns synthesis.

say_en.text: Compare three models' views on this architecture
say_en.note: Claude runs tri-model parallel and combines.
